UP Shahjahanpur ECCE Educator Online Form 2026 – Full Details

UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal has released the notification for the post of ECCE Educator in the Department of Basic Education Uttar Pradesh (Shahjahanpur). This recruitment has been issued for 168 posts. The online application process for UP Shahjahanpur ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026 has started on 05 October 2026, and candidates can apply till 21 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UP Shahjahanpur ECCE Educator Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 05 October 2026
  • Last Date : 21 October 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : 0/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • No Application Fees For Any Candidates

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
